verdict.rationale: Exa documents an official, open-source MCP server, including a hosted endpoint at https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp, with setup guides for Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT, Codex and other MCP clients. It exposes web search, fetching, Exa Agent and Exa Connect tools, needs no API key to start, and is listed as an official plugin in OpenAI's plugin directory; a probe confirms the docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.
